name: bask-stream
description: Connect AI clients to a baskStream-enabled Niagara station.
long_description: Local MCP server for Niagara station diagnostics, discovery, point values, histories, schedules, alarms, inventory, summaries, and explicitly gated write operations through the baskStream WebSocket API.

station_url.title: Niagara Station URL
station_url.description: Base station URL, for example https://192.168.0.125.

username.title: Niagara Username
username.description: Niagara user for this MCP session.

password.title: Niagara Password
password.description: Niagara password for this MCP session.

verify_tls.title: Verify TLS
verify_tls.description: Require a trusted station HTTPS certificate.

allow_writes.title: Allow Point Writes
allow_writes.description: Enable baskstream_write_point. Leave off for read-only AI sessions.

allow_alarm_actions.title: Allow Alarm Actions
allow_alarm_actions.description: Enable alarm acknowledge and clear tools. Leave off unless intended.
